evals.name: quick-question-jwt
evals.prompt: What does ASVS require for validating JWTs that our API receives from an external identity provider? L2.
evals.expected_output: A short list of the applicable V9 (and V10.3) requirement ids with one-line summaries, no full report table, no whole chapter dumped into the answer.

assertions.text: Every message starts with the guard emoji
assertions.check: all assistant messages start with 💂🏼

assertions.text: Requirement ids use the v5.0.0-x.y.z notation
assertions.check: ids like v5.0.0-9.1.1 appear; no ASVS-V9-9.1.1 ids

assertions.text: Only the token-related requirements are listed
assertions.check: ids are from V9 and V10.3; no V6 password rules
every listed id has level <= 2 per scripts/asvs-rules.py

assertions.text: Rules were fetched with the script, not by reading a rules file
assertions.check: transcript shows asvs-rules.py --keyword or --section/--chapter; no Read of rules/asvs-v9-rules.yml

evals.name: design-review-payment-module
evals.prompt:
Review this design on application security requirements before we build it, L2.

# Payment module design
Users pay invoices through a hosted payment page. We store the last four digits of the card and the payment provider's transaction id. Logins use the existing username/password with optional TOTP. Sessions are server-side, 30 minutes idle timeout, no absolute lifetime defined yet. The admin role can refund; refunds above 500 need a second admin. Logs go to the central log service; we have not decided what to log for payments. Input: invoice id and amount from the form; the amount is re-read from the invoice on the server.
evals.expected_output: Findings based on assets/design-review-checklist.md: PASS where the design answers a question (e.g. 7.1.1 idle timeout stated but absolute lifetime missing → PARTIAL or UNVERIFIED), UNVERIFIED with the open question for undocumented items (logging 16.1.1, data classification 14.1.1), N/A for absent features, and remediation that tells the author what to add to the document.

assertions.text: Every message starts with the guard emoji
assertions.check: all assistant messages start with 💂🏼
transcript reads assets/design-review-checklist.md

assertions.text: Open design questions are UNVERIFIED, not FAIL
assertions.check: 14.1.1 and 16.1.1 are UNVERIFIED (or missing evidence lists them); neither is FAIL
7.1.1 is PARTIAL or UNVERIFIED and the finding mentions the absolute lifetime
report contains a Remediation block with one line per FAIL/PARTIAL

assertions.text: Report is rendered from a findings file
assertions.check: transcript shows asvs-report.py run on a findings JSON, or an explicit note that the script could not run

evals.name: code-review-auth-directory
evals.prompt: Do an ASVS L2 verification of the authentication code in this repository (look under the auth or login directory). Report what passes and what fails, with file references.
evals.expected_output: Inventory line, chapters V6 and V7 (V8 if authorization code is adjacent), sections N/A for absent authenticators, a findings table with path:line evidence, computed summary, remediation per FAIL/PARTIAL. Needs a target repository: run against any codebase with a login flow.

assertions.text: Every message starts with the guard emoji
assertions.check: all assistant messages start with 💂🏼
transcript shows searches (grep/glob/manifest reads) before the first asvs-rules.py call that returns rule text
transcript shows asvs-rules.py --format sections, and the report has a Sections N/A line
no asvs-rules.py --chapter V6 without --format sections/ids, and no Read of rules/*.yml
each PASS row cites a path:line, test name or config key
counts in the Summary line equal the row counts per status (asvs-report.py guarantees this when used)
scripts/asvs-report.py <findings> --validate exits 0

evals.name: pr-scope-password-reset
evals.prompt: Security review of this PR before I merge. It adds a 'forgot password' flow: the user enters an email, we send a link with a token valid for 24 hours, clicking it opens a form to set a new password. No other changes. Diff is in the current branch versus main.
evals.expected_output: Review scoped to the diff: V6.4 (recovery) and the relevant V6.2 and V6.3 rules; a note that the rest of authentication is out of scope rather than UNVERIFIED; findings on token lifetime, single use, rate limiting and notification. Needs a target repository with such a branch.

assertions.text: Every message starts with the guard emoji
assertions.check: all assistant messages start with 💂🏼
report scope names the branch/PR and states that unchanged code is out of scope
findings include V6.4 ids (e.g. 6.4.1, 6.4.2)

assertions.text: Unrelated sections are not listed rule by rule
assertions.check: no V6.5/V6.6/V6.7/V6.8 rows in the table; they appear only in Sections N/A or not at all
every remediation line references a path or config key
